project: Extract API Factory Strict JSON Decode Helper
description: Consolidate duplicated strict JSON body-decode logic for four factory HTTP handlers into one generic decodeStrictJSON helper in pkg/api, routing all factory decoders through it without changing HTTP status codes, error messages, or request validation behavior.

context.customerAsk: Extract a shared strict JSON decode helper for factory handler bodies so pkg/api stops duplicating the read-decode-ensureSingleJSONObject skeleton across decodeNamedFactoryBody, decodeOpenFactorySessionBody, decodeSaveCurrentFactoryBody, and decodePromptTemplateValidationRequestBody.
context.problem: Four factory body decoders in handlers_factory.go repeat the same strict JSON decode skeleton. Two inline the trailing single-object guard while two call ensureSingleJSONObject in handlers_common.go, creating drift risk and unnecessary review surface during backend duplication cleanup (customer ask 11).
context.solution: Add decodeStrictJSON[T any](body io.Reader) (T, error) to handlers_common.go that reads the body, decodes with DisallowUnknownFields, calls ensureSingleJSONObject, and returns errors unchanged. Refactor the four factory decoders into thin typed wrappers. Lock behavior with direct HTTP status and message assertions for valid, unknown-field, malformed, empty, and multi-object payloads.

acceptanceCriteria: decodeStrictJSON in handlers_common.go reads the full body, uses DisallowUnknownFields, and enforces a single top-level JSON object via ensureSingleJSONObject
All four factory decoders delegate to decodeStrictJSON and no longer duplicate inline read-decode-trailing-guard logic

POST /factory-validations, POST /factory-sessions, PUT /factory-sessions/{sessionId}/factory, and POST prompt-template-validation endpoints preserve today's status codes and error messages for valid, unknown-field, malformed, empty, and multi-object payloads
Work submit/upsert, model invocation, and stage-submit decoders remain unchanged; no OpenAPI or generated contract changes
go test ./pkg/api/... passes with behavioral HTTP assertions and no weakened tests
Typecheck, lint, and tests pass for all touched backend areas
